scripts.# health:check:fast: removed 2026-11-19 — health:check ya corre en paralelo con tsc incremental
scripts.docs:clientes:audit: npm run docs:clientes:integridad --silent && npm run docs:clientes:texto --silent && npm run docs:consistency --silent && npm run docs:clientes:ubicacion && npm run docs:clientes:pdf
scripts.educacion:check: npm run educacion:pdf && npm run educacion:preview && npm run educacion:qa
scripts.educacion:pdf: node --import tsx src/education/render-study-guide.ts --guide tecnologia-1-secundaria/guia-estudio && node --import tsx src/education/render-study-guide.ts --guide tecnologia-1-secundaria/cuaderno-practicas
scripts.educacion:preview: node --import tsx src/education/preview-study-guide.ts --guide tecnologia-1-secundaria/guia-estudio && node --import tsx src/education/preview-study-guide.ts --guide tecnologia-1-secundaria/cuaderno-practicas
scripts.educacion:qa: node --import tsx src/tools/qa-print-html.ts --dir docs/educacion/tecnologia-1-secundaria/guia-estudio --label guia-estudio && node --import tsx src/tools/qa-print-html.ts --file docs/educacion/tecnologia-1-secundaria/cuaderno-practicas/cuaderno-practicas.html --label cuaderno-practicas
scripts.gates:selftest: node --import tsx --test src/tools/skills-accessibility-gate.test.ts src/tools/conflict-marker-gate.test.ts src/tools/gitignore-source-guard.test.ts src/tools/dependabot-alerts-gate.test.ts src/tools/app-typecheck-coverage-gate.test.ts src/tools/app-design-gate.test.ts src/tools/skills-surfaces.test.ts src/tools/decks-guion-coverage-gate.test.ts src/tools/quality-gates-verify.test.ts src/tools/decks-facts-drift-gate.test.ts src/tools/glossary-export.test.ts src/tools/script-policy-gate.test.ts src/ops/stack-audit-apps.test.ts src/monitor/multi-channel-alert.test.ts src/tokens/token-spike-guard.test.ts src/tools/model-inference-probe.test.ts src/tools/orphan-module-gate.test.ts && node src/tools/src-tests-runner.mjs
scripts.gv:build: npm run gv:protect && npm run gv:installer
scripts.infrastructure:dev: start npm run gateway:dev && start npm run notifications:dev
scripts.infrastructure:start: npm run gateway:start && npm run notifications:start
scripts.test:rdd: npx tsx tests/unit/rdd/risk-classifier.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/rdd/rdd-kill-switch.test.ts

prepare: lefthook install || echo "lefthook skipped (no git context)"
